what: AI-personal assistant that owns a computer, phone and email and just executes tasks after a message from your phone.
why_us: High-engagement wish (206 likes, 43 replies, 37 bookmarks) from a Notion AI product person. Recurring category: agent that finishes the last mile instead of another chat box.
revenue: N/A (paid-agent TAM; users already pay $20-200/mo for Cursor/Claude)

what: Voice-first calorie tracker: speak a meal in natural language, AI logs macros without MyFitnessPal search friction. Market cited $1.75B with 70% 30-day churn.
why_us: Documented retention pain + explicit $9.99/mo pricing suggestion. Fitness tracking is a paying vertical; logging friction is the documented killer.
engagement: idea thread; newsletter vault with 750 ideas

what: AI coding tools (Warp, Replit, Rocket.new, Atoms) billed as productivity but users report credits burning in minutes, $250 for a 2h run, $3k spent on broken generated apps, refunds refused.
why_us: Repeatable Trustpilot 1-star pattern across multiple vibe-coding products in Sep 2026. Demand gap is predictable pricing + working output, not another wrapper.

what: Cursor/Copilot G2 cons cluster: steep $20+/mo, token limits, extra spend to avoid caps, inaccurate suggestions. Teams stacking Copilot+Cursor+Claude without ROI visibility.
why_us: Paying developers + CFOs want spend control and fair usage. Opportunity: usage auditor, cheaper agent, or predictable flat-rate coding agent.
engagement: Cursor expensive (5 mentions), Copilot expensive (25+ mentions)

what: Jon Yongfook (Bannerbear / image-video automation) bootstrapping SaaS at $81K MRR. Thread on death of build-in-public: sell to non-technical buyers in unsaturated niches.
why_us: Hard revenue number + distribution lesson: quiet B2B automation to non-devs beats public MRR flex.

what: Niche iOS charging-animation app: under 5k downloads, ~$40k/month. Thesis: precise demand selection beats traffic.
why_us: Concrete micro-app economics. Validates unsexy App Store utilities with tiny DAU and high ARPU.
engagement: repost of proven selection essay, Sep 21 2026

what: Recoura launched on Stripe App Marketplace: recovers failed payments / expired cards (involuntary churn) for Stripe and Square.
why_us: Direct monetization of a universal SaaS pain (failed MRR). Stripe marketplace distribution is a repeatable channel.
revenue: % of recovered revenue (typical 1-5% of recovered MRR)
engagement: just passed Stripe app review; marketplace listing live

what: Startmate / Batko list of AI startups someone should build now that Claude/Codex make building cheap: productized services customized by an agent at onboard.
why_us: Operator with deal-flow saying demand is visible in audits. Aligns with wrapping AI inside one operational job, not generic chat.

what: Notion Trustpilot: support fails for months, €4 compensation on €24 paid, Business plan jumping to €29/mo, mobile app bugged. Users hunting alternatives.
why_us: Switching intent from a large paying base. Workspace tools that stay reliable and cheap can steal churn.

what: Someone should build a web search that is just grep. 85 likes from Databricks Search/Agents engineer.
why_us: Developer-grade demand for deterministic search vs LLM-slop SERP. Small tool, high willingness among technical buyers.
